name: ArchiSteamFarm
author: contact@piotrunius.dev
description:
ArchiSteamFarm (ASF) is a C# application that allows you to farm Steam cards using multiple Steam accounts simultaneously. It features a web-based IPC interface for remote management.

https://github.com/JustArchiNET/ArchiSteamFarm

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
cd /mnt/server

# Download ASF
echo "==> Downloading ArchiSteamFarm..."
if [ -n "${ASF_URL}" ]; then
  curl -fsSL "${ASF_URL}" -o asf.zip
elif [ "${ASF_VERSION}" = "latest" ] || [ -z "${ASF_VERSION}" ]; then
  curl -fsSL "https://github.com/JustArchiNET/ArchiSteamFarm/releases/latest/download/ASF-linux-x64.zip" -o asf.zip
else
  curl -fsSL "https://github.com/JustArchiNET/ArchiSteamFarm/releases/download/${ASF_VERSION}/ASF-linux-x64.zip" -o asf.zip
fi

unzip -o asf.zip && rm -f asf.zip && chmod +x ArchiSteamFarm

# Resolve IPC password: use provided value or generate a random one
mkdir -p config
if [ -n "${IPC_PASSWORD}" ]; then
  IPC_PW="${IPC_PASSWORD}"
else
  IPC_PW=$(tr -dc A-Za-z0-9 < /dev/urandom | head -c 24)
  echo "==> IPC password: ${IPC_PW}"
fi

# Write ASF.json global config
printf '{"CurrentCulture":"en-US","Headless":true,"IPC":true,"IPCPassword":"%s","AutoRestart":false}' "$IPC_PW" > config/ASF.json

# Write IPC.config
printf '{"Kestrel":{"Endpoints":{"HTTP":{"Url":"http://0.0.0.0:%s"}}}}' "${SERVER_PORT}" > config/IPC.config

# Set permissions: binary executable, config files restricted
chmod 640 config/ASF.json config/IPC.config

echo "==> Installation complete"
echo "==> IPC interface: http://${SERVER_IP}:${SERVER_PORT}"
